verdict.answer: No, as long as you meet all the conditions. The EU driving time rules do not apply to vehicles of up to 7,5 tonnes that carry materials, equipment or machinery for the driver's own use at work. The conditions are: you drive only within a 100 km radius of your firm's base; driving is not your main activity; and the transport is not done for hire or reward. A 6-tonne truck carrying a carpenter's tools to sites up to 80 km away fits this exclusion. If any condition fails, for example you start carrying goods for others for payment or you go beyond 100 km, the rules can apply, because they cover goods vehicles over 3,5 tonnes. Commission clarification note 3 from 2007 describes this only as an optional exemption limited to 50 km. That note is older than the current Regulation, which sets the 100 km limit, so follow the Regulation. Your country may still have its own national rules for vehicles outside the EU scope.
